year3.title: The Curious Little Otter
year3.imagePrompt: a curious playful otter exploring a sparkling river with smooth pebbles and lily pads, children's book illustration, detailed watercolour, magical woodland scene, whimsical
lines: Oliver the otter lived beside a sparkling river.
Every morning he would explore the smooth river stones.
One day he discovered a shiny silver key underwater.
He wondered what amazing treasure the key might unlock.
His clever friend, a wise old turtle, had an idea.
Together they followed the river until they reached a cave.
Inside the cave was a small wooden chest covered in moss.
The key fit perfectly and the chest opened with a creak.
It was full of beautiful coloured pebbles collected long ago.
Oliver and the turtle laughed and shared the treasure with everyone.

year3.title: Bramble the Brave Badger
year3.imagePrompt: a brave little badger wearing a small red scarf walking through an enchanted forest at twilight, fireflies glowing, children's book illustration, magical watercolour, whimsical and cosy
lines: Bramble the badger was the smallest animal in the forest.
The other creatures often teased him because of his tiny size.
One evening, a terrible storm shook the trees and scattered the birds.
A baby squirrel became trapped beneath a heavy fallen branch.
Bramble was the only one brave enough to crawl underneath.
He pushed with all his strength and freed the frightened squirrel.
The animals of the forest cheered loudly for their tiny hero.
From that day on, nobody ever teased Bramble about his size.
They learned that courage has nothing to do with being big.
